At v4.40.0 / 8cb0261a26b7d986955fe0a6780f076dcb7902e7, ExifReader.load -> loadView -> ImageHeader.parseAppMarkers: isHeicFile/isAvifFile wrap parseBox(0) in try/catch, then findHeicOffsets/findAvifOffsets call findOffsets unguarded. findMetaBox only requires offset+8 <= byteLength, then parseBox/getBoxLength read past that header: hasEmptyHighBits does dataView.getUint32(offset+8) when boxLength===1, and parseBox does dataView.getUint8(contentOffset) for any non-ftyp/iprp/ipco/colr type. A valid ftyp/heic or ftyp/avif followed by an 8-byte free/abcd box or a truncated extended-size box (size==1, no 64-bit field) therefore throws RangeError out of load(). CVE.org/cvelistV5 currently have no CVE-2026-53496 record (nvd_published_at null on OSV); that is unpublished MITRE, not a withdrawn/rejected advisory.
